verdict.rationale: Stripe documents its own 'analyze with AI' capability: an agent can query aggregated account data such as MRR, churn templates and SQL against reporting tables through Stripe's stripe_analytics MCP tool. Radar applies AI algorithms to assess fraud risk on transactions in real time. However, the insight generation runs in the user's external AI agent rather than inside the Stripe product, and Radar covers only fraud risk scoring, not general data insights. missing for 10: a native in-Dashboard AI assistant that generates insights or suggestions, proactive AI recommendations from account data, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: You can use an AI agent to analyze aggregated data across your Stripe account ... query metrics such as monthly recurring revenue (MRR)
Metric queries for Stripe-defined metrics such as MRR and gross volume; Template runs for subscription and billing metrics such as churn rate and subscriber counts
Use Radar to evaluate transactions, accounts, and customers in real time, using AI algorithms to assess the risk of fraud.
